ownerNotes.notes: Owner decision 2026-10-10 (Significant-Hobbies/ph-catalog#14): techdata is public, indexable and requires no authentication. R2 bucket stays private, served only through allowlisted Worker routes. Collectors stay in their repos; techdata only reads until parity. Open: deployment origin, deploy approval, fate of the five source sites, where collectors live.

purpose: One public entry point to browse, search and export Nomad Atlas, High Signal Podcasts, Reddit Insights, Research Papers and PH Catalog with source provenance.

directory.description: A public data workbench for five collections with search, filters, comparison and source-attributed exports.
